_comment: Extensions gnosh refuses to load in Phosh because they modify GNOME Shell internals that Phosh does not have. Users can override with `gnosh config allow-unsupported true`. Shared by the runtime, the CLI and the website.

incompatible.blur-my-shell@aunetx: blurs GNOME Shell's panel, overview and dash with compositor effects; Phosh has no compositor effect hooks
incompatible.dash-to-dock@micxgx.gmail.com: replaces GNOME Shell's dash and overview; Phosh has its own app grid and overview
incompatible.ubuntu-dock@ubuntu.com: replaces GNOME Shell's dash and overview; Phosh has its own app grid and overview
incompatible.dash-to-panel@jderose9.github.com: replaces GNOME Shell's top panel and dash with a taskbar; Phosh's panels cannot be replaced
incompatible.just-perfection-desktop@just-perfection: tweaks GNOME Shell's own UI elements, which do not exist in Phosh
incompatible.quick-settings-tweaks@qwreey: rearranges GNOME Shell's built-in quick settings; Phosh has its own quick settings
incompatible.auto-move-windows@gnome-shell-extensions: moves windows between workspaces; Phosh has no workspaces
incompatible.launch-new-instance@gnome-shell-extensio: changes GNOME Shell's app grid behaviour; Phosh has its own app grid
incompatible.user-theme@gnome-shell-extensions.gcampa: loads GNOME Shell themes; Phosh is themed with GTK themes
incompatible.workspace-indicator@gnome-shell-extensio: shows and switches workspaces; Phosh has no workspaces
incompatible.window-list@gnome-shell-extensions.gcamp: adds a window list at the bottom of the GNOME Shell stage; Phosh has no such panel
incompatible.native-window-placement@gnome-shell-exte: changes GNOME Shell's overview window layout
adds keyboard navigation to GNOME Shell's overview
incompatible.pop-shell@system76.com: tiles windows through Mutter; phoc manages windows itself
incompatible.forge@jmmaranan.com: tiles windows through Mutter; phoc manages windows itself
incompatible.tiling-assistant@leleat-on-github: tiles windows through Mutter; phoc manages windows itself
incompatible.gTile@vibou: tiles windows through Mutter; phoc manages windows itself
incompatible.ding@rastersoft.com: draws desktop icons in a window placed by Mutter
incompatible.arcmenu@arcmenu.com: replaces GNOME Shell's activities button and app menu with a full launcher
incompatible.space-bar@luchrioh: shows and switches workspaces; Phosh has no workspaces
incompatible.rounded-window-corners@fxgn: rounds window corners with compositor shaders
